tasks.label: Compilar Sistema (g++)
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude src/main.cpp src/cadastros.cpp src/consultas.cpp src/ordenacao.cpp src/recursao.cpp src/simulacao.cpp -o build/sistema

tasks.label: Compilar e Executar Sistema
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude src/main.cpp src/cadastros.cpp src/consultas.cpp src/ordenacao.cpp src/recursao.cpp src/simulacao.cpp -o build/sistema && ./build/sistema

tasks.label: Compilar e Rodar Testes
tasks.command: mkdir -p build && g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Iinclude tests/testes_automatizados.cpp src/cadastros.cpp src/consultas.cpp src/ordenacao.cpp src/recursao.cpp src/simulacao.cpp -o build/testes && ./build/testes
